Synopsis:
Shadowheart discovers that she has resistance to the shadow curse. She also suspects the presence of the shar temple and wants to look for it.

Cluster Contexts:
- CAMP_Shadowheart_CRD_ShadowCurse.json: Shadowheart is traveling with the party and has just read a book in a druid grove that mentions a Shar temple and a mysterious "shadow curse." The party is in an area touched by that curse and others are affected, but she notices she’s unusually resistant — which convinces her Shar is protecting her. That discovery prompts her to reveal (or confirm) that she worships the Dark Lady; she’s excited, a bit defensive, and eager rather than frightened. She concludes Shar must want something from her and wants to find where the goddess’s power is strongest (a Shar temple or stronghold) and investigate it. Other camp business or NPCs may be active off-screen, but they don’t change the immediate fact that Shadowheart’s faith and resistance drive her to seek out the source of the shadow power.
- GOB_SeluneTemple_OM_ShadowHeart_AOM_OOM.json: Shadowheart pauses and reflects to herself after entering the main chamber of what was once an impressive temple dedicated to the moon goddess, Selune. Being a worshipper of Selune's rival, Shar, Shadowheart is satisfied to see the temple ruined and full of goblins, but also is curious as to what happened. She may suspect that fellow Sharrans were active in the region at some point in the past, and may have been responsible for the temple's desecration.
- GOB_SeluneTemple_OM_ShadowHeart_COM.json: Shadowheart, enters the inner area of the goblin camp - what was clearly once the central hall of a Temple dedicated to Selûne, the rival of Shadowheart's goddess, Shar. She notes that this must have once been a key area for Selûnite power and wonders what happened here. If she discovered earlier clues, she may believe Sharran allies destroyed this place long ago. The player may or may not be aware of Shadowheart's shar worshop at this point, and can attempt to pry the info from her.
- GOB_ShadowHeart_VB_Temple.json: Venturing farther into what is now a goblin camp but was once a temple of Selûne (the moon goddess, rival to her own goddess, Shar), Shadowheart reacts with disgust. She notes how the crude goblin decoration is an improvement upon the surviving signs of Selûne worship. If Shadowheart isn't known to be a Shar worshipper, her comments are a little more veiled.
- GOB_ShadowHeart_VB_Mural.json: On approaching an ancient mural in the goblin camp, Shadowheart recognises it was once decorated to honour the moon goddess. Selûne. A worshipper of Selûne's rival, Shar, Shadowheart reacts with distaste and ill ease (if Shadowheart hasn't revealed her true nature yet, her observations are a little more veiled.)

It's a good thing that I'm resistant to the shadows - this way I can help you. || [context] CinematicNodeContext: Sceptical reaction from the player after SH's first line. Shadowheart pauses and reflects to herself after entering the main chamber of what was once an impressive temple dedicated to the moon goddess, Selune. Being a worshipper of Selune's rival, Shar, Shadowheart is satisfied to see the temple ruined and full of goblins, but also is curious as to what happened. She may suspect that fellow Sharrans were active in the region at some point in the past, and may have been responsible for the temple's desecration.

Shadowheart, enters the inner area of the goblin camp - what was clearly once the central hall of a Temple dedicated to Selûne, the rival of Shadowheart's goddess, Shar. She notes that this must have once been a key area for Selûnite power and wonders what happened here. If she discovered earlier clues, she may believe Sharran allies destroyed this place long ago. The player may or may not be aware of Shadowheart's shar worshop at this point, and can attempt to pry the info from her.

Venturing farther into what is now a goblin camp but was once a temple of Selûne (the moon goddess, rival to her own goddess, Shar), Shadowheart reacts with disgust. She notes how the crude goblin decoration is an improvement upon the surviving signs of Selûne worship. If Shadowheart isn't known to be a Shar worshipper, her comments are a little more veiled.

On approaching an ancient mural in the goblin camp, Shadowheart recognises it was once decorated to honour the moon goddess. Selûne. A worshipper of Selûne's rival, Shar, Shadowheart reacts with distaste and ill ease (if Shadowheart hasn't revealed her true nature yet, her observations are a little more veiled.)
context: Shadowheart and the party are in an area touched by a mysterious "shadow curse" she read about in a book at a druid grove; while others here suffer, she notices she is unusually resistant. That resistance convinces her Shar, the Dark Lady, is protecting and favoring her, so she either reveals or confirms that she worships Shar—she's excited, a little defensive, and eager rather than frightened. From that she reasons Shar must want something from her, and she resolves to find where the goddess’s power is strongest (a Shar temple or stronghold) to investigate. The player may react with surprise or scepticism; other camp business and the ruined Selûne temple/goblin camp are happening off‑screen but don't change Shadowheart’s determination.
